current_prompt: What does Sanji find after Zoro returns from Kuma's bargain?

corrected_source.episodeTitle: The Pain of My Crewmates Is My Pain! Zoro's Desperate Fight!
corrected_source.title: Crunchyroll episode page

finding: Verified as written. Episode 377 is in the Thriller Bark arc. After Kuma's bargain, Sanji reaches Zoro and finds him covered in blood; Zoro conceals the pain he took from Luffy by saying that nothing happened. The existing answer (option 2, answerIndex 1: blood on the ground and no trace of Luffy's pain) is supported, though English episode-title wording varies by source.
